{
  "type_map": {
    "FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "IPV4_SRC_ADDR": "nominal",
    "L4_SRC_PORT": "integer",
    "IPV4_DST_ADDR": "nominal",
    "L4_DST_PORT": "integer",
    "PROTOCOL": "integer",
    "L7_PROTO": "integer",
    "IN_BYTES": "integer",
    "IN_PKTS": "integer",
    "OUT_BYTES": "integer",
    "OUT_PKTS": "integer",
    "TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "DURATION_IN": "integer",
    "DURATION_OUT": "integer",
    "MIN_TTL": "integer",
    "MAX_TTL": "integer",
    "LONGEST_FLOW_PKT": "integer",
    "SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT": "integer",
    "MIN_IP_PKT_LEN": "integer",
    "MAX_IP_PKT_LEN": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES": "integer",
    "TCP_WIN_MAX_IN": "integer",
    "TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT": "integer",
    "ICMP_TYPE": "integer",
    "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE": "integer",
    "DNS_QUERY_ID": "integer",
    "DNS_QUERY_TYPE": "integer",
    "DNS_TTL_ANSWER": "integer",
    "FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_MIN": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_MAX": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_AVG": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_STDDEV": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_MIN": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_MAX": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_AVG": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_STDDEV": "integer"
  },
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "DEF1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] == (df['FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS'] - df['FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS'])"
      ],
      "features": ["FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS", "FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS"],
      "rationale": "Flow duration is defined as end time minus start time."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['LONGEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MAX_IP_PKT_LEN']"
      ],
      "features": ["LONGEST_FLOW_PKT", "MAX_IP_PKT_LEN"],
      "rationale": "Longest packet and max IP packet length refer to the same measurement."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MIN_IP_PKT_LEN']"
      ],
      "features": ["SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT", "MIN_IP_PKT_LEN"],
      "rationale": "Shortest packet and min IP packet length refer to the same measurement."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']) == (df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES'])"
      ],
      "features": [
        "IN_PKTS",
        "OUT_PKTS",
        "NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES",
        "NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES"
      ],
      "rationale": "Total packet count equals the sum of packets across all IP size bins."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['TCP_FLAGS'] == (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] | df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS']))",
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 6) | (df['TCP_FLAGS'] == (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] + df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS']))"
      ],
      "features": ["TCP_FLAGS", "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS", "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "Cumulative TCP flags of the flow should combine client and server flags, either by bitwise OR or addition."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256)",
        "(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == (df['ICMP_TYPE'] >> 8))"
      ],
      "features": ["ICMP_IPV4_TYPE", "ICMP_TYPE", "PROTOCOL"],
      "rationale": "ICMP_TYPE is defined as type*256+code, so ICMP_IPV4_TYPE is the quotient by 256."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF7",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_IN'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['DURATION_IN']), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_IN'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['DURATION_IN']), True)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES",
        "IN_BYTES",
        "OUT_BYTES",
        "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS",
        "DURATION_IN"
      ],
      "rationale": "Src-to-dst bytes per second may be computed from IN_BYTES or OUT_BYTES and either total flow duration or active stream duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF8",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_OUT'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['DURATION_OUT']), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_OUT'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 1000 // df['DURATION_OUT']), True)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES",
        "IN_BYTES",
        "OUT_BYTES",
        "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS",
        "DURATION_OUT"
      ],
      "rationale": "Dst-to-src bytes per second may be computed from IN_BYTES or OUT_BYTES and either total flow duration or active stream duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF9",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] * 8",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 8 * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 8 * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT",
        "SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES",
        "IN_BYTES",
        "OUT_BYTES",
        "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS"
      ],
      "rationale": "Throughput in bps is bytes per second times 8, equivalently computed directly from byte count and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEF10",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] * 8",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 8 * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'] == (df['IN_BYTES'] * 8 * 1000 // df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS']), True)"
      ],
      "features": [
        "DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT",
        "DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES",
        "IN_BYTES",
        "OUT_BYTES",
        "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS"
      ],
      "rationale": "Throughput in bps is bytes per second times 8, equivalently computed directly from byte count and duration."
    }
  ]
}
